current_bottleneck: Naive full-covariance Student-t NLL is too diffuse and poorly coupled in free-run sampling. It broadens marginals, collapses effective shared shocks, damages surface validity, and erases mean reversion. The issue is not AR factorization alone but the unrestricted covariance/scale parameterization under this objective.
